User Guide

This guide explains how to write a custom cuDisc simulation. It follows the structure of the example simulations in codes/ and covers each step in order. For the physical motivation behind each component, refer to Physics and Numerics.

  • The Grid
  • Fields and Data Storage
  • Gas Structure and Evolution
  • Dust Dynamics
  • Opacities
  • Temperature and Radiative Transfer
  • Dust Coagulation and Fragmentation
  • Time-stepping
  • Output and Analysis

Overview

A cuDisc simulation is a C++ program that links against the cuDisc static library (lib/libcudisc.a). The standard workflow is:

  1. Create a Grid — defines the computational mesh in (R, θ) space.

  2. Create a SizeGrid — defines the logarithmic grain-size bins.

  3. Load opacities — read and interpolate a DSHARP_opacs table.

  4. Allocate fields — create Field and Field3D objects for all physical quantities.

  5. Set initial conditions — fill the fields with the desired starting state.

  6. Construct solvers — instantiate DustDynamics, FLD_Solver, and a coagulation integrator.

  7. Run the time loop — advance the simulation, calling each solver in operator-splitting order, and write output.

Headers are in headers/ and sources in src/. All public-facing types live in the headers/ directory; there is no separate namespace — names are accessed directly.

Typical include block

Most simulations include:

#include "grid.h"           // Grid, GridRef, create_field, create_field3D
#include "field.h"          // Field<T>, Field3D<T>
#include "cuda_array.h"     // CudaArray<T>
#include "constants.h"      // au, Msun, year, GMsun, sigma_SB, ...
#include "dustdynamics.h"   // DustDynamics, Prims, BoundaryFlags
#include "sources.h"        // Sources (drag, settling source terms)
#include "gas1d.h"          // 1D gas evolution
#include "hydrostatic.h"    // compute_hydrostatic_equilibrium
#include "stellar_irradiation.h"  // Star, compute_stellar_heating_with_scattering
#include "DSHARP_opacs.h"   // DSHARP_opacs, SizeGrid
#include "FLD.h"            // FLD_Solver, WavelengthBinner
#include "bins.h"           // WavelengthBinner
#include "file_io.h"        // write_file, write_grids, read_restart_file
#include "coagulation/coagulation.h"   // CoagulationRate
#include "coagulation/integration.h"   // BS32Integration
#include "coagulation/fragments.h"     // SimpleErosion, BirnstielKernel
